Phi_SE, ymax = Phi + Phi_SE),                 width = 0.25, color = "grey30") +   geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +   coord_flip() +   labs(title    = "Nogueira size corrected stability per variant",        subtitle = "Error bars = ±1 SE  |  Dashed line = random selection null (Φ̂ = 0)",        x = NULL, y = expression(hat(Phi))) +   theme_bw() final_models <- lapply(names(VARIANTS), function(vname) {   variant <- VARIANTS[[vname]]   row     <- tune[[vname]]$best_row    sc <- screen_control(     drop_fraction = row$screen_drop,     min_ntree     = 500L   )   sl <- select_control(     pi_thr           = row$pi_thr,     n_reps          = 25L,     min_ntree        = 500L,     shadow_mode      = variant$shadow_mode,     unassigned_modules = "unassigned",     use_cfres = variant$use_cfres,     cfres_scope        = variant$cfres_scope   )    y_tv_f <- factor(y_tv, levels = c(1, 0), labels = c("BCR/ABL", "NEG"))    set.seed(42)   fit <- mf(X_tv, y_tv_f,             module_membership = module_membership,   # global, from WGCNA section             screen_params     = sc,             select_params     = sl,             backend           = "python",             seed              = 42L,             verbose           = 0L)    stable <- fit$feature_list$feature_name   rf <- ranger::ranger(     y ~ ., probability = TRUE, num.trees = 300L, seed = 1L,     data = data.frame(y = factor(y_tv), X_tv[, stable, drop = FALSE])   )   prob <- predict(rf, data.frame(X_test[, stable, drop = FALSE]))$predictions[, 2]    list(     fit        = fit,                       # full MF object for your own plots     test_auc   = as.numeric(pROC::auc(y_test, prob, quiet = TRUE)),     test_brier = mean((prob - y_test)^2),     n_stable   = length(stable)   ) }) names(final_models) <- names(VARIANTS)  # Honest test vault performance per variant (selected variant flagged) test_tbl <- data.frame(   Variant    = names(final_models),   Test_AUC   = round(vapply(final_models, `[[`, numeric(1), "test_auc"),   3),   Test_Brier = round(vapply(final_models, `[[`, numeric(1), "test_brier"), 3),   n_stable   = vapply(final_models, `[[`, integer(1), "n_stable"),   Selected   = ifelse(names(final_models) == best_v, "<<", ""),   row.names  = NULL ) knitr::kable(test_tbl, align = "lcccc",              caption = "Held out test vault performance (selection made on validation only).")

code: # \donttest{ # Two blocks of correlated features; WGCNA finds the modules set.seed(1) n <- 30 z1 <- rnorm(n); z2 <- rnorm(n) block <- function(k, zz) as.data.frame(replicate(k, zz + rnorm(n, sd = 0.4))) X <- cbind(block(10, z1), block(10, z2)) colnames(X) <- paste0("g", seq_len(ncol(X))) y <- z1 - z2 + rnorm(n, sd = 0.3) fit <- wmf(X, y, WGCNA_params = WGCNA_control(power = 6, min_features = 6),            screen_params = screen_control(min_ntree = 30),            select_params = select_control(n_reps = 3, min_ntree = 30),            final_ntree = 30, backend = "R", verbose = 0, seed = 1) table(fit$WGCNA_object$colors) #>  #>      blue turquoise  #>        10        10  # }
